es: Contar un cambio de hábito: qué dejaste, qué probaste, qué recuerdas o lamentas y qué vas a seguir haciendo.

teaching.en: My goal was to change my evening routine.
teaching.es: Mi objetivo era cambiar mi rutina de la tarde.
teaching.explanationEs: Goal + was to + verbo: presenta el objetivo al empezar el relato.
teaching.audioText: My goal was to change my evening routine.

teaching.en: First, I stopped eating late, and it was a small step.
teaching.es: Primero dejé de comer tarde, y fue un paso pequeño.
teaching.explanationEs: Stopped + gerundio cuenta lo que dejaste; first ordena el relato.
segments: First, I stopped eating late, and
teaching.audioText: First, I stopped eating late, and it was a small step.

teaching.en: Then I tried reading in bed, and the result was good.
teaching.es: Luego probé a leer en la cama, y el resultado fue bueno.
teaching.explanationEs: Tried + gerundio cuenta algo que probaste; result da el efecto.
segments: Then I tried reading in bed,
teaching.audioText: Then I tried reading in bed, and the result was good.

teaching.en: I always remember to check my plan on Sunday.
teaching.es: Siempre me acuerdo de revisar mi plan el domingo.
teaching.explanationEs: Remember + to + verbo: un hábito nuevo que ya no olvidas.
teaching.audioText: I always remember to check my plan on Sunday.

teaching.en: I regret not starting earlier, but I am making progress.
teaching.es: Lamento no haber empezado antes, pero estoy progresando.
teaching.explanationEs: Regret + not + gerundio: lamentar algo que no hiciste.
teaching.audioText: I regret not starting earlier, but I am making progress.

teaching.en: I will go on walking every day, because I have a good reason to keep going.
teaching.es: Seguiré caminando cada día, porque tengo un buen motivo para continuar.
teaching.explanationEs: Go on + gerundio: el plan de futuro; reason explica por qué.
segments: I will go on walking every day, because
I have a good reason to keep going.
teaching.audioText: I will go on walking every day, because I have a good reason to keep going.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase expresa bien el objetivo de dejar de comer tarde?

choices.text: My goal was stop eating late.
My goal was to stop eating late.
My goal was stopping to eat late.

feedback.es: Tras My goal was va to + verbo base, y stop + gerundio expresa dejar un hábito: to stop eating.

hint.es: Después de goal was va to; después de stop, el gerundio.

prompt.es: Completa: «Probé a comer fruta en lugar de pastel y el resultado fue bueno.»

feedback.es: Tried + gerundio cuenta algo que probaste como experimento: tried eating.

hint.es: Es algo que probaste para ver qué pasaba.

origin.text: I tried ___ fruit instead of cake, and the result was good.

feedback.es: Regret + not + gerundio lamenta algo que no hiciste: not starting earlier.

prompt.es: Cierra el relato con el plan. ¿Qué frase encaja?

choices.text: I will stop swimming every Sunday.
I regret swimming every Sunday.
I will go on swimming every Sunday.

feedback.es: Go on + gerundio expresa que seguirá con el hábito. Stop lo dejaría y regret lo lamentaría.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué hizo Leo para cambiar su rutina.

choices.text: He went to the gym before work.
He stopped going to the gym.
He went to the gym after work.

feedback.es: Tried going cuenta el experimento de Leo: ir al gimnasio antes del trabajo. Al final se siente bien.

origin.audio: Last month, Leo tried going to the gym before work. It was hard, but now he feels good.

prompt.es: Completa: «Siempre me acuerdo de escribir mi plan el domingo.»

feedback.es: Remember + to + verbo: un hábito nuevo que ya no olvidas.

origin.text: I always remember ___ my plan on Sunday.

prompt.es: Escribe como Tom el cambio de su hábito (80–100 palabras).

answer.text: My goal was to sleep better, so I stopped drinking coffee after six. At first it was difficult, and I felt tired. Then I tried drinking tea in the evening, and the result was good. Now I remember to buy tea every Sunday, so I always have some at home. I regret not changing my routine earlier, because I lost many good nights. I will go on drinking tea, and I will keep this habit because it is a small step with a big result.
accepted: My goal was to sleep better, so I stopped drinking coffee after six. At first it was difficult, and I felt tired. Then I tried drinking tea in the evening, and the result was good. Now I remember to buy tea every Sunday, so I always have some at home. I regret not changing my routine earlier, because I lost many good nights. I will go on drinking tea, and I will keep this habit because it is a small step with a big result.

I wanted to sleep better, but I drank coffee at night. I stopped having coffee after six, and then I tried drinking tea in the evening. The result was good, and I felt more relaxed. Now I remember to buy tea on Sundays, so I never run out of it. I regret not changing my habit earlier, because I slept badly for months. I will keep drinking tea every day, and I will make this plan part of my routine.

feedback.es: Un buen relato nombra lo que dejó (stopped drinking), lo que probó (tried drinking), lo que recuerda (remember to buy), lo que lamenta (regret not changing) y su plan.

origin.text: Datos de Tom: quería dormir mejor y su hábito era tomar café por la noche. Dejó de tomar café después de las seis. Probó a beber té por la tarde y el resultado fue bueno. Ahora se acuerda de comprar té los domingos. Lamenta no haber cambiado antes y piensa seguir con el té.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige cuál es el cambio de Sara.

choices.text: She now eats more at night.
She no longer eats at night.
She stops at night to eat something.

feedback.es: Stopped eating at night significa que dejó de comer por la noche, que es el cambio. Stop to eat sería parar para comer.

origin.audio: Sara always ate late, but last month she stopped eating at night.

prompt.es: Según el diario de Mia, ¿qué probó?

choices.text: Running after work.
Swimming before work.
Swimming after work.

feedback.es: Tried swimming after work: Mia probó nadar después del trabajo y siguió todo el mes.

origin.text: Mia's diary: In January I tried swimming after work. I was tired, but I went on all month. I regret not starting before.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Mi objetivo es beber más agua esta semana.»

answer.text: My goal is to drink more water this week

feedback.es: Goal is to + verbo base presenta el objetivo; this week lo sitúa en el tiempo.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase dice que Ana lamenta algo que ya hizo?

choices.text: Ana regrets eating late every night.
Ana remembers eating late every night.
Ana stopped eating late every night.

feedback.es: Regrets eating lamenta algo ya hecho. Remembers eating solo lo recuerda, y stopped eating dice que lo dejó.

prompt.es: Escribe una frase con tu objetivo de cambio de hábito.

answer.text: My goal is to walk every day.
accepted: My goal is to walk every day.
I want to walk every day.
My goal is to go for a walk every day.

feedback.es: El objetivo se dice con goal is to + verbo base: to walk every day.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué hace Leo ahora.

choices.text: He runs every morning.
He walks instead of running.
He stopped going out.

feedback.es: Tried to run fue un intento que no funcionó: por el cansancio ahora camina.

origin.audio: Leo tried to run every morning, but he was too tired, so now he walks.
